BrochureContent.Content:
Sherry FitzGerald Radford are delighted to present to the market this superbly located and exceptionally well-maintained detached four-bedroom dormer residence extending to approximately 153.7 sq.m presented in turnkey condition throughout.

This impressive home showcases quality craftsmanship and thoughtful finishes at every turn, including solid timber flooring, elegant ceiling coving, recessed lighting, and beautifully proportioned living spaces filled with natural light. Designed with both comfort and practicality in mind, the accommodation is spacious and versatile, ideal for modern family living.

The welcoming entrance hall provides access to all principal rooms on the ground floor, including a stylish living room, cosy family room, spacious kitchen/dining area, utility room, family bathroom, and a generously sized ground-floor bedroom offering excellent flexibility for guests, home working, or ground-floor living requirements.

Upstairs, there are three further well-appointed bedrooms, including a superb principal bedroom with ensuite bathroom, together with a separate contemporary shower room.

Externally, the property is equally impressive. Set amidst beautifully maintained lawns with mature trees and established hedging, the grounds offer exceptional privacy and a peaceful elevated setting. The surrounding countryside enjoys spectacular views, with Mount Leinster visible to one side and Hook Lighthouse to the other — a truly special feature of this charming home. A large detached garage provides excellent storage and houses the oil burner and well pump, while a sweeping driveway with generous turning circle offers ample off-street parking.

The location is second to none, situated just 1.2 km from Taghmon Village and its excellent range of amenities including primary schools, shops, and GAA facilities, while also enjoying convenient access to Wexford Town and its extensive amenities and services. Rosslare Europort is approximately a 30-minute drive away, while Dublin Airport can be reached in approximately two hours.

Altogether, this is a rare opportunity to acquire a truly outstanding family home in a peaceful yet highly convenient setting.
